title: दस सिर, दस हज़ार साल की तपस्या
art_style: Tholu Bommalata (Andhra leather shadow puppet): translucent dyed-leather figures with perforation dots, backlit by an oil-lamp screen
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda (कैकसी और विश्रवा; गोकर्ण में तपस्या)
music_sfx: आंध्र कठपुतली का मृदंगम; सिर गिनते समय हर बार एक गहरी थाप; ब्रह्मा के प्रकट होने पर शंख
characters: Dashagriva/Ravan (ten crowned heads = centre + 5 left + 4 right; dark-red upper, black dhoti, gold angavastram)
Brahma (four faces, three visible; on lotus)
Kubera (only as Pushpak vimana in sky)
frame: 1080x1920 (9:16), safe zone: top 220px + bottom 400px kept free of faces/text

shots.chars: — a crowned puppet head (Dashagriva's) tumbling into the fire
shots.action: head falls into flames, flames leap up and spread across the screen
shots.light: fire from below, orange-red; puppet screen glow behind
shots.layers: FG: flame tongues | MG: falling head | BG: amber screen glow
shots.vfx: flames spreading to the frame edges, sparks, heat haze
shots.sfx: SFX: whoosh + fire roar, mridangam hit
shots.anim: head falls 40px/frame with slow rotation; flames scale up 30% in 10 frames; no blood — the head turns to light/ash.

shots.vo: रावण ने अपना एक सिर काटकर आग में चढ़ा दिया।
shots.chars: Dashagriva seated in tapas before fire, all 10 heads; sword raised to his outermost head (cut before contact)
shots.action: lifts sword toward one side head
shots.light: fire key from below-front; cool rim from screen
shots.layers: FG: fire | MG: Dashagriva | BG: puppet screen
shots.anim: sword rises 12 frames; cut away at the top — never show the cut; fire flares 6 frames.

shots.move: slow tilt down from blood-red sun to hermitage
shots.chars: Kaikesi small, walking to Vishrava's hut
shots.layers: FG: dry branch | MG: hut + Kaikesi | BG: red sun, crows
shots.anim: tilt 200px; crows wing loop 6 frames; Kaikesi walk 12 frames/loop.

shots.vo: विश्रवा ने कहा, तुम्हारे पुत्र क्रूर राक्षस होंगे।
shots.chars: Kaikesi kneeling screen-left facing right; Vishrava seated screen-right facing left
shots.action: Vishrava raises his hand and pronounces
shots.light: red sunset through the doorway behind Vishrava; Kaikesi in shadow
shots.layers: FG: Kaikesi | MG: Vishrava | BG: red doorway
shots.anim: Vishrava hand rise 14 frames, mouth sync; Kaikesi head lift 10 frames.

shots.vo: और जन्मा एक बालक, दस सिरों के साथ…
shots.chars: newborn in a cradle; ten small crowned heads fanning out (iconography: 10 heads)
shots.action: baby's heads open eyes one by one
shots.light: single oil lamp, warm pool of light
shots.layers: FG: cradle rim | MG: baby | BG: dark screen
shots.sfx: SFX: baby cry layered ten times (soft)
shots.anim: eyes open in sequence 2 frames apart, centre last.

shots.chars: the ten heads (adult) filling the frame
shots.action: all ten pairs of eyes snap open together
shots.sfx: SFX: ten deep drum beats in one roll
shots.anim: snap zoom 6 frames; eyes open 3 frames.

shots.vo: उसने आसमान में अपने सौतेले भाई
shots.chars: Pushpak vimana gliding across a golden sky
shots.action: vimana crosses frame R→L trailing light
shots.layers: FG: palm silhouettes | MG: vimana | BG: clouds
shots.trans: match on look: cut to S08 looking up
shots.anim: vimana moves 300px over 2.5s; trails fade 8 frames.

shots.action: eyes follow the vimana; jaw tightens
shots.light: gold light from the vimana on his faces, rest in shade
shots.anim: eyes track 12 frames; brow furrow 6 frames.

shots.vo: माँ ने कहा, तुम इससे भी बड़े बनो।
shots.move: slow pan up to the sky on 'बड़े बनो'
shots.chars: Kaikesi screen-left behind him, hand on his shoulder, pointing to the sky; Dashagriva screen-right
shots.action: she points up; he turns his heads to her
shots.light: sunset key from right, deep shadows
shots.layers: FG: terrace pillar | MG: mother + son | BG: sky with vimana far away
shots.anim: point gesture 12 frames; heads turn 10 frames; tilt up 150px.

shots.vo: गोकर्ण में शुरू हुई दस हज़ार साल की तपस्या।
shots.move: static; seasons cycle across the screen
shots.chars: Dashagriva seated in lotus pose before the fire on the Gokarna shore
shots.action: sits motionless while rain, sun, snow pass
shots.layers: FG: fire | MG: Dashagriva | BG: sea, hills
shots.vfx: rain streaks / falling leaves / snow passes
shots.anim: season cycle every 20 frames; puppet completely still; fire flicker only.

shots.vo: हर हज़ार साल पर, एक सिर अग्नि में।
shots.chars: Dashagriva with 9 heads remaining; a glowing head-shaped light rises into the fire
shots.light: fire flare lights him from below
shots.layers: FG: fire | MG: Dashagriva (9 heads) | BG: dark sea
shots.anim: flare 8 frames each thaap; heads count down — 9 visible here.

shots.move: two quick push-ins, one per count
shots.action: with each count the outer heads fade into light

shots.layers: MG: single head | BG: wall of fire
shots.anim: fire wall rises 20 frames; head motionless.

shots.vo: कोई डर नहीं, कोई दर्द नहीं।
shots.expr: no fear, no pain; eyes reflect the fire

shots.vo: उसे बस एक चीज़ चाहिए थी… देवताओं से भी बड़ी शक्ति।
shots.move: crane up from him to the sky
shots.chars: Dashagriva small at bottom; faint deva figures above in the clouds
shots.action: he looks up at the heavens
shots.light: lightning flashes from above, fire from below
shots.layers: FG: fire | MG: Dashagriva | BG: ghostly devas, storm clouds

shots.vo: उसने आख़िरी सिर काटने को तलवार उठाई…
shots.chars: Dashagriva (one head) raises the sword high
shots.action: sword at the top of the arc — everything stops
shots.light: fire low; sword edge catches the only light
shots.anim: sword rises 14 frames then HOLD 12 frames absolutely still. Never show contact.

shots.chars: Brahma (four faces, three visible) seated on a lotus in golden light above; Dashagriva below, sword lowered
shots.action: golden light bursts; Brahma raises hand in blessing
shots.light: golden divine light from above, god-rays
shots.layers: FG: Dashagriva silhouette | MG: lotus | BG: gold rays
shots.anim: light burst 6 frames; lotus opens 16 frames; rays rotate slowly.

shots.vo: रावण ने क्या माँगा? पूरी कहानी, नीचे link में।
shots.chars: Dashagriva kneeling, looking up, hands joined; golden light on his face
shots.vfx: CTA arrow bounce in the bottom space
